Der Dow-Jones-Index der Standardwerte notierte zur Eröffnung 0,2 Prozent tiefer bei 51.410 Punkten. Der breiter gefasste S&P 500 gab 0,4 Prozent auf 7673 Zähler nach. Der Index der Technologiebörse Nasdaq verlor 0,7 Prozent auf 26.723 Stellen.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Anhaltende Sorgen über die geopolitische Lage haben die US-Börsenindizes am Donnerstag ins Minus gedrückt. Der Dow-Jones-Index (.DJI) der Standardwerte notierte zur Eröffnung 0,2 Prozent tiefer bei 51.410 Punkten. Der breiter gefasste S&P 500 (.SPX) gab 0,4 Prozent auf 7673 Zähler nach. Der Index der Technologiebörse Nasdaq (.IXIC) verlor 0,7 Prozent auf 26.723 Stellen. Investoren blickten mit Spannung auf das [USN:L6N45F1AF TEXT:"Gipfeltreffen"] des US-Präsidenten Donald Trump mit dem chinesischen Staatschef Xi Jinping, bei dem es um die Regulierung von Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI), den Iran-Krieg und die Spannungen um Taiwan gehen soll. Noch vor den für Donnerstag geplanten Gesprächen erklärte US-Finanzminister Scott Bessent, dass die beiden Wirtschaftssupermächte bereits vereinbart hätten, ihren Waffenstillstand im Handelsstreit bis zum 10. Januar zu verlängern. "Diese Verlängerung fiel kürzer aus, als von US-Vertretern im Vorfeld angedeutet worden war, bietet jedoch mehr Zeit, um eine längerfristige Einigung zu erzielen", schrieben die Analysten der Deutschen Bank. Ein Schlagabtausch zwischen den USA und dem Iran bei der UN-Generalversammlung trieb die Preise für Nordsee-Rohöl Brent und US-Leichtöl WTI um mehr als zwei Prozent nach oben. Bereits am Mittwoch hatte sich Brent um fast vier Prozent auf mehr als 100 Dollar je Fass (159 Liter) verteuert. Die Aussicht auf steigende Kraftstoffkosten hievte am Donnerstag die Aktien von US-Fluggesellschaften wie United Airlines (UAL.O) , JetBlue (JBLU.O) und American Airlines (AAL.O) um jeweils rund ein Prozent ins Plus. Die erneut steigenden Energiepreise verstärkten die Zinsängste der Anleger. Laut dem Präsidenten der regionalen Notenbank von New York, John Williams, könnte der Leitzins in den USA in diesem Jahr noch einmal angehoben werden müssen. Händler schätzen die Wahrscheinlichkeit für eine Zinserhöhung im kommenden Monat inzwischen auf 71 Prozent ein. Die Rendite der 30-jährigen US-Staatsanleihe erreichte den höchsten Stand seit 2004.

item.title: Brasil tem capacidade de atrair investimento em IA, questão é como se posicionar, diz BlackRock
item.description: O Brasil tem capacidade de atrair investimentos relacionados à inteligência artifical, mas a questão é como se posicionar de uma forma mais competitiva, afirmou nesta quinta-feira o presidente-executivo da BlackRock Brasil, Bruno Barino.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Brasil tem capacidade de atrair investimentos relacionados à inteligência artifical, mas a questão é como se posicionar de uma forma mais competitiva, afirmou nesta quinta-feira o presidente-executivo da BlackRock Brasil, Bruno Barino. "O Brasil tem a energia que é o mais complexo em várias localidades de pegar, e toda a capacidade de fazer. A questão agora é como desenvolver um arcabouço regulatório e competir o recurso a nível global", afirmou o executivo em evento da Monte Bravo em São Paulo. Barino disse que uma vantagem dessa cadeia de IA é que muitas das operações são vinculadas em dólar, então já existe um hedge cambial no investimento. O executivo destacou que o cenário da BlackRock não é de bolha de IA, citando que há um "ramp-up" de custos, mas em breve começarão a ser observados os benefícios na produtividade em toda a cadeia. Barino afirmou que a IA deve levar a um volume de investimento de US$5 trilhões a US$8 trilhões nos próximos quatro a cinco anos quando se pensa na cadeia longa, que começa no data center e vai até a aplicação final. "Isso reconfigura totalmente o mundo."

item.title: Google plans first test of AI chips in space under Project Suncatcher
item.description: Alphabet's Google said on Thursday it will launch a prototype satellite next week in its first in-orbit test of Project Suncatcher, a research effort to explore whether space could potentially host large-scale AI computing infrastructure.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Google said on Thursday it will launch a prototype satellite next week in its first in-orbit test of Project Suncatcher, a research effort to explore whether space could potentially host large-scale AI computing infrastructure. Companies including SpaceX (SPCX.O) and Starcloud are pursuing plans to deploy data centers in low Earth orbit, aiming to harness near-continuous sunlight to power energy-intensive AI computing and sidestep terrestrial constraints on electricity supplies. The new mission, scheduled to fly on SpaceX's upcoming Transporter-18 rideshare launch in partnership with satellite company Planet Labs (PL.N) , will assess how Google's AI hardware withstands launch forces, radiation and extreme temperatures in LEO. After the launch, it will send a prototype satellite carrying Google Tensor Processing Units into low Earth orbit to assess if the AI chips can operate reliably in space. Space radiation can disrupt or degrade electronics, including by causing data errors known as bit flips. Google said it tested its TPUs while running AI workloads in a facility at the University of California, Davis, but that orbital testing was needed to understand how the hardware performs in the real environment. The company will also evaluate its design to cool the power-intensive chips in the vacuum of space, where conventional airflow cooling is impossible, by combining heat pipes with radiators. But experts have said that the concept remains years from being commercially viable given high launch costs, engineering constraints and satellite production bottlenecks. The first Suncatcher mission is designed to gather in-orbit data and identify potential failure points, rather than demonstrate an operational orbital data center, Google said. It aims to launch two satellites in 2027 to test the high-bandwidth laser links needed to connect future computing clusters.

item.title: Ben Rice hopes to add to homer total as Yankees battle Rays
item.description: Aaron Judge said he wants to return for next week's wild-card series. Until he does come back, the slugger and the rest of the New York Yankees will be curious to see if slugger Ben Rice can homer again.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Aaron Judge said he wants to return for next week's wild-card series. Until he does come back, the slugger and the rest of the New York Yankees will be curious to see if slugger Ben Rice can homer again. With four games remaining, Rice is among seven MLB players with at least 40 home runs, and he will attempt to continue his late-season surge Thursday night when New York hosts the Tampa Bay Rays, the American League East champion. The Yankees (91-67) are assured of hosting the wild-card series and probably will face the Boston Red Sox for the second straight year. New York might be without Judge, who is dealing with a strained right calf after playing in seven games following being out with a fractured right rib. On Monday, manager Aaron Boone described Judge's strain as moderate and indicated he was not necessarily expecting the three-time American League MVP to be available. After the Yankees improved to 50-42 in games Judge has missed with Wednesday's 9-2 rout of the Rays, the eight-time All-Star expressed confidence in his ability to return by next week. "My goal is to come back as soon as I can," Judge said. "If you ask me if I'm going to be back, I'm gonna tell you, yeah, I'm doing everything I can every single day I show up here to get back and be ready to go." Judge expressed confidence in his return after watching Rice hit a pair of solo homers on Wednesday, giving him 41 home runs in his second full season. Rice had three hits and a walk and is batting .349 with five homers in his past 12 games and .333 with seven homers and 17 RBIs in his past 27. For the season, he is batting .263 with 97 RBIs after finishing with 26 homers, 65 RBIs and a .255 batting average last year. "Each year, he's gotten better," Judge said of the 27-year-old. "Each month he's gotten better. Even through bad slumps, he's just making the reads and making the changes he needs to get back to his normal self. So it's been fun to watch. He's a complete player." Rice is hitting .381 against the Rays (96-62), who clinched the AL East with a 6-1 win over the Yankees on Tuesday night. After clinching, the Rays on Wednesday sat Yandy Diaz, who had a pair of two-run singles in the clincher. Junior Caminero will be in the lineup to keep his streak of playing each game going but likely will be replaced after a few at-bats. Caminero took two at-bats and was lifted for a pinch hitter in the sixth. "I just want to see good health and some guys freshened up," Tampa Bay manager Kevin Cash said. "It's been a long season. They've played really hard to get to this point. Let's find a way to continue to get our work in, and I know and trust that whoever's on that field, they're going to do everything they can to win games." Whoever is in the lineup for the Rays will face right-hander Cam Schlittler (14-6, 1.94 ERA), who will make his final regular-season start before likely starting Game 1 of the wild-card series. Since lasting 4 1/3 innings in an 8-2 loss to the Los Angeles Dodgers on July 19, Schlittler is 5-0 with a 1.46 ERA in his past 11 starts. The Yankees fell to 20-12 in his starts on Saturday when he allowed one earned run on three hits in six innings in a no-decision during a 5-3 loss at Arizona. Schlittler is 1-2 with a 2.63 ERA in four career starts against the Rays. Left-hander Ian Seymour (9-7, 4.38 ERA) originally was slated to start Wednesday but had his start pushed back a day to give Freddy Peralta extra rest to face Philadelphia on Friday. Seymour is 0-1 with a 5.79 ERA in three starts this month, including Friday's 4-2 loss to Boston when he allowed four runs on seven hits in five innings. One of his best starts this season occurred July 7 in Tampa Bay when he struck out 12 in 5 1/3 innings during a 6-4 win over the Yankees. -Field Level Media

item.title: Indian minister says UAE, Saudi Arabia keen to invest in refining sector
item.description: India's oil minister, Hardeep Singh Puri, said on Thursday the United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia are interested in investing in India's refining sector.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India's oil minister, Hardeep Singh Puri, said on Thursday the United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia are interested in investing in India's refining sector. "Nobody wants to come and invest in a refinery unless they can also get a slice of your growing downstream market," Puri said at an event. India, the world's third-biggest oil importer and consumer, aims to expand its refining capacity to 6.2-6.4 million barrels per day from the current about 5.4 million bpd by building new plants and upgrading the existing units, he said. Puri said the cost of building a refinery was huge, about 780 billion to 800 billion rupees ($8.13-$8.34 billion). "So yeah, they're very keen on these investments", he added. ($1 = 95.9550 Indian rupees)

item.title: Governo deve prorrogar subvenção de R$2,12 por litro de diesel, diz Moretti
item.description: O ministro do Planejamento e Orçamento, Bruno Moretti, afirmou nesta quinta-feira que o governo tende a prorrogar a subvenção de R$2,12 por litro de diesel, que venceria nesta semana, mantendo o mesmo valor do benefício vigente hoje.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O ministro do Planejamento e Orçamento, Bruno Moretti, afirmou nesta quinta-feira que o governo tende a prorrogar a subvenção de R$2,12 por litro de diesel, que venceria nesta semana, mantendo o mesmo valor do benefício vigente hoje. Em entrevista coletiva para detalhar projeções fiscais, Moretti afirmou que a prorrogação pode ser de 30 dias, mas destacou que ainda não há decisão final, o que ocorrerá após consulta ao presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Segundo ele, o governo mantém o objetivo de retirar o benefício assim que houver dissipação do choque de preços do petróleo motivado pela guerra no Oriente Médio.

item.title: Déficit por cuenta corriente EEUU se amplía fuertemente en el segundo trimestre
item.description: El déficit por cuenta corriente de Estados Unidos se amplió considerablemente en el segundo trimestre debido al fuerte aumento de las importaciones de bienes, según datos oficiales publicados el jueves.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El déficit por cuenta corriente de Estados Unidos se amplió considerablemente en el segundo trimestre debido al fuerte aumento de las importaciones de bienes, según datos oficiales publicados el jueves. La Oficina de Análisis Económico del Departamento de Comercio indicó que el déficit por cuenta corriente, que mide el flujo de bienes, servicios e inversiones que entran y salen del país, aumentó en 33.400 millones de dólares, es decir, un 15,7%, a los 246.000 millones de dólares el pasado trimestre. Los datos correspondientes al trimestre de enero a marzo se revisaron a la baja, situando el déficit en 212.600 millones de dólares, en lugar de los 226.800 millones estimados anteriormente. Los economistas encuestados por Reuters habían pronosticado que el déficit por cuenta corriente se ampliaría hasta los 255.000 millones de dólares. El déficit por cuenta corriente del segundo trimestre representó el 3,0% del Producto Interno Bruto, frente al 2,7% registrado en el trimestre de enero a marzo. Alcanzó su máximo, el 6,3%, en el tercer trimestre de 2006. Aunque el déficit por cuenta corriente no tiene repercusión en el dólar, dada la condición de esta moneda como divisa de reserva, crece la preocupación por los crecientes déficits gemelos del país. Las importaciones de bienes se dispararon en 67.400 millones de dólares, a los 931.600 millones de dólares. Este aumento superó el incremento de 27.100 millones de dólares registrado en las exportaciones de bienes, que se situaron en 640.300 millones de dólares. Como resultado, el déficit comercial de bienes se amplió en 40.400 millones de dólares, a los 291.300 millones de dólares. El comercio restó 1,14 puntos porcentuales al PIB en el segundo trimestre y ha supuesto un lastre durante tres trimestres consecutivos. La balanza de rentas primarias se redujo hasta los 11.400 millones de dólares el último trimestre, frente a los 15.800 millones del trimestre de enero a marzo. Los ingresos por rentas primarias aumentaron hasta los 416.200 millones de dólares, frente a los 391.500 millones del trimestre anterior. Los pagos por rentas primarias aumentaron hasta los 427.600 millones de dólares, frente a los 407.300 millones del primer trimestre. La posición de inversión internacional del país, la diferencia entre los activos y pasivos financieros en el extranjero de los residentes en Estados Unidos, se deterioró ligeramente hasta un déficit de 22,42 billones de dólares al final del segundo trimestre, frente al déficit de 21,27 billones registrado en el primer trimestre. Los activos ascendieron a 46,97 billones de dólares, mientras que los pasivos alcanzaron los 69,39 billones de dólares.

item.title: Parece que Infantino se quedará, pero la FIFA se enfrenta a una nueva lucha por el poder
item.description: La batalla para forzar la salida de Gianni Infantino de la FIFA puede estar a punto de terminar, apenas unas semanas después de que sus oponentes pensaran que iban a destronar al presidente del organismo rector del fútbol mundial, pero la lucha por el alcance de su poder puede que no haya hecho más que empezar.
item.dc:creator: Julien Pretot
item.content:encoded: La batalla para forzar la salida de Gianni Infantino de la FIFA puede estar a punto de terminar, apenas unas semanas después de que sus oponentes pensaran que iban a destronar al presidente del organismo rector del fútbol mundial, pero la lucha por el alcance de su poder puede que no haya hecho más que empezar. Las figuras más destacadas del fútbol mundial ven cada vez más cómo la crisis desencadenada por el plan de inversión privada abandonado por Infantino se aleja de la cuestión de la sucesión y se orienta hacia una lucha por las condiciones de su permanencia en la presidencia. Un posible desenlace podría ser un compromiso de gobernanza por el que Infantino permanezca en el cargo, pero ceda parte de su poder. La otra posibilidad es una prolongada "guerra fría-caliente" en la que clubes, confederaciones, representantes de jugadores y federaciones nacionales se enfrenten repetidamente a la FIFA en torno a las competiciones, el dinero y el control del calendario internacional. "Lo que está claro ahora (…) es que no va a ir a ninguna parte", declaró a Reuters un alto ejecutivo del fútbol mundial. "Una guerra fría-caliente es un problema muy real para la FIFA y para el fútbol mundial". Un veterano directivo deportivo internacional, que lleva décadas trabajando con organismos reguladores, ofreció una valoración similar, afirmando que Infantino está "aguantando", pero cuestionando cómo podría funcionar la FIFA si muchos de los países e instituciones más poderosos del fútbol siguieran oponiéndose a él. "Se produciría, en la práctica, una guerra civil dentro de la gobernanza, algo que no recuerdo que haya ocurrido antes en un organismo deportivo", afirmó el directivo. "No tiene precedentes". Ese posible escenario de una guerra fría prolongada y potencialmente perjudicial dentro del fútbol mundial fue corroborado de forma independiente a Reuters por otros dos altos cargos del fútbol. Esta perspectiva apunta a un desenlace potencialmente paradójico para una crisis que, en su punto álgido, amenazó el puesto de Infantino: podría sobrevivir políticamente mientras preside un organismo rector en el que algunas de las principales partes interesadas del fútbol tratan de limitar lo que realmente puede hacer. "¿Se convertirá en un presidente sin poder real?", preguntó el veterano directivo. LA CONFIANZA SIGUE ROTA Hay pocos indicios de que el intento de Infantino esta semana de poner punto y final a la crisis haya reparado la ruptura. En una carta dirigida al Consejo de la FIFA y a los presidentes de las 211 federaciones miembro, Infantino propuso que se considere la posibilidad de encargar una revisión externa independiente del marco de gobernanza de la FIFA para las principales iniciativas estratégicas. También propuso celebrar consultas con las confederaciones, las federaciones y otras partes interesadas sobre el fortalecimiento de la toma de decisiones y afirmó que sigue plenamente comprometido con el liderazgo de la FIFA. Varias federaciones europeas rechazaron con rapidez la medida, y el presidente de la UEFA, Aleksander Ceferin, emitió el miércoles una dura valoración. "El proyecto que hizo añicos la unidad del fútbol mundial puede que haya sido abolido, pero la confianza que rompió no ha vuelto", afirmó en un discurso en video pronunciado en la Cumbre del Fútbol de Portugal. "La confianza en nuestro deporte se sustenta en tres pilares: la unidad, la transparencia y una gobernanza al servicio de la mayoría, no de unos pocos", comentó. "El fútbol no está en venta". Ceferin no mencionó a Infantino por su nombre, pero sus comentarios fueron una clara referencia a la propuesta de vender a inversores privados una participación del 20% en los derechos comerciales de la FIFA, incluidos los derechos relacionados con el Mundial. El proyecto se abandonó en julio tras la oposición de la UEFA, el organismo rector del fútbol europeo, la Confederación Asiática de Fútbol y la Confederación Norteamericana de Fútbol (Concacaf). DESGASTE Para Infantino, de 56 años y de origen suizo-italiano, esto deja una única vía hacia un acuerdo menos conflictivo: una reforma lo suficientemente sustancial como para convencer a sus oponentes de que el poder dentro de la FIFA ha cambiado de verdad. El alto ejecutivo del fútbol mundial señaló que un posible resultado podría ser la creación de un nuevo órgano o estructura que diluya la autoridad del presidente. Las propuestas de gobernanza de Infantino eran el "mínimo indispensable" necesario para darle margen para permanecer en el cargo, señaló el directivo, añadiendo que la cuestión es si él aceptaría cambios significativos. El alcance de cualquier compromiso dependería de "cuánto esté dispuesto a ceder Infantino" y de cuánto estén dispuestos a luchar sus oponentes para arrebatárselo, señaló el alto ejecutivo del fútbol mundial. Hay una ironía histórica en tal desenlace. Las reformas introducidas tras la caída del expresidente de la FIFA Sepp Blatter tenían como objetivo, en parte, reducir el poder concentrado en la presidencia. Sin embargo, las figuras más destacadas ven ahora cómo se gesta otra batalla sobre cuánta autoridad debería ejercer el presidente de la FIFA. Si no se llega a un acuerdo, la alternativa podría ser un desgaste más que un enfrentamiento espectacular. El directivo afirmó que los clubes podrían enfrentarse a la FIFA por el Mundial de Clubes, el reparto de ingresos y la cesión de jugadores; los representantes de los jugadores podrían impugnar el calendario; las federaciones podrían obstaculizar iniciativas; y algunas confederaciones podrían oponerse a los intentos de ampliar o reformar las competiciones de la FIFA. "Quizá parezca que ahora nos estamos reduciendo a dos opciones", afirmó el directivo. "Una, un compromiso en el que Gianni ceda parte de su poder y se creen nuevos órganos; o, dos, una guerra fría permanente en la que todas las partes implicadas se enfrenten en cada asunto". Esto podría incluir la ampliación de las Copas del Mundo, los Mundiales de Clubes más grandes o más frecuentes y decisiones sobre la distribución de los ingresos comerciales, señaló el directivo. El resultado no sería necesariamente una ruptura formal con la FIFA. En cambio, los opositores podrían dificultar la puesta en marcha de todas las iniciativas importantes. El veterano ejecutivo deportivo señaló que el reto tocaba de lleno el núcleo del funcionamiento de los organismos reguladores mundiales. "La importancia de la unidad. Mantener unidas estas gigantescas organizaciones deportivas; no son partidos políticos. Esto será un territorio desconocido", comentó. INFANTINO SE RECUPERA Hay otra razón por la que la atención se está desplazando hacia la convivencia con Infantino en lugar de su sustitución: su posición parece haberse fortalecido desde que estalló la crisis. El presidente de una federación nacional, que habló con Reuters bajo condición de anonimato, cree que los opositores de Infantino dejaron pasar su mejor oportunidad cuando la reacción negativa estaba en su punto álgido y que ahora está recuperando apoyos de cara a las elecciones de marzo. El presidente de la FIFA tendrá una sucesión de oportunidades en los próximos meses para reunirse con los dirigentes de las federaciones nacionales en torneos, congresos y eventos de las confederaciones, incluidas varias reuniones en África. El presidente de la federación espera que Infantino aproveche esas reuniones para mantener el apoyo entre los dirigentes del fútbol de cara a las elecciones presidenciales de la FIFA de marzo de 2027. La importancia política de las federaciones más pequeñas también quedó patente en una propuesta de Ceferin y del presidente de la Concacaf, Víctor Montagliani, para que la FIFA distribuya al menos 10 millones de dólares de sus reservas a cada una de sus 211 federaciones miembro durante el próximo ejercicio financiero. Para muchas federaciones que dependen en gran medida de la financiación de la FIFA, estas sumas podrían suponer un cambio radical. Si Infantino resulta reelegido, el presidente de la asociación cree que algunas federaciones que se han opuesto a él podrían acabar mostrándose menos hostiles, al llegar a la conclusión de que hay poco que ganar con cuatro años de confrontación permanente. Esa posibilidad significa que una "guerra fría" no es inevitable.

item.title: Japan schoolboy Ohashi shrugs off COVID to smash 200m breaststroke world record
item.description: Little more than a week after coming down with COVID-19, 17-year-old schoolboy Shin Ohashi lit up the Asian Games pool with a breaststroke world record that left Japan wondering whether a successor to Kosuke Kitajima had emerged.
item.dc:creator: Ian Ransom
item.content:encoded: Little more than a week after coming down with COVID-19, 17-year-old schoolboy Shin Ohashi lit up the Asian Games pool with a breaststroke world record that left Japan wondering whether a successor to Kosuke Kitajima had emerged. Ohashi stormed to his second gold of the Games with a time of 2:04.83 in the 200m event at the Tokyo Aquatics Centre, smashing the previous record (2:05.48) set by China's Qin Haiyang at the 2023 world championships in Fukuoka. Big things were expected of Ohashi at this meet, having won five medals at last year's world junior championships. Falling ill in the leadup was not ideal but he said being forced to take some rest may have helped him. "Regarding COVID, after all, there was a part where it created a little anxiety for me mentally," said Ohashi, who shared the 100m breaststroke gold with China's Dong Zhihao three days ago, with Qin taking bronze. "But, conversely, physically it was very -- well, in a sense, I think it was good that I was able to properly rest my body as a period of recovery." Olympic champion Leon Marchand, who visited the Games pool this week, described Ohashi as a "scary" prospect ahead of the Frenchman's defence of his 200m breaststroke title at Los Angeles 2028. NATURAL MUSCLE His coach Shin Ota said he was a great learner, even if like many high school boys, he was often glued to his phone. "He has this kind of absent-minded appearance, and looks as though he's not thinking about anything, but, yeah, he really loves swimming and he's incredibly enthusiastic about studying it," said Ota, admitting the world record was a surprise to him. "I've answered this in various interviews, but I have this sense that I hardly teach him anything. "But, as you can see, he's got a lot of muscle, but it's not as though he's doing weight training. It's natural muscle, so I think that's another part of what's remarkable about him." Japan has a proud history in the breaststroke, and counts Kitajima as one of the nation's swimming greats. Kitajima claimed back-to-back 100 and 200m breaststroke gold medals at the 2004-08 Olympics, the only swimmer to achieve that "double-double". Ohashi's coach said it was early days for Ohashi but he could see him following Kitajima onto an Olympic podium. "While gaining those experiences one by one and getting accustomed to them, I think he'll surely be able to win a medal at the Olympics as well," said Ota. "And for him to become like Kitajima, he'll also need to grow as a person."

item.title: Brewers eye elusive century mark in series finale vs. Phillies
item.description: The Milwaukee Brewers have never won 100 games in a season, but they have a chance to reach that milestone Thursday when they conclude their road series with the Philadelphia Phillies.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Milwaukee Brewers have never won 100 games in a season, but they have a chance to reach that milestone Thursday when they conclude their road series with the Philadelphia Phillies. After losing 6-4 in Tuesday's series opener, Milwaukee (99-59) evened things up with a 4-1 triumph on Wednesday. The Brewers' 11th win in 14 games put them on the precipice of the century mark with four games left in the regular season. Logan Henderson allowed just one run over five innings in his final tune-up before the postseason. He'll follow Jacob Misiorowski in the playoffs, giving Milwaukee a formidable 1-2 punch. "He's been fantastic for us. Unsung hero, for sure," Milwaukee manager Pat Murphy said of Henderson. "Miz getting all the attention, but this kid has matched him in a lot of ways, just his consistency and getting outs." The Brewers already have clinched a first-round bye, although they are hoping to finish ahead of the Los Angeles Dodgers (97-61) for the best record in the majors and home-field advantage throughout the postseason. The Phillies (87-71), meanwhile, entered Wednesday with a magic number of two to secure a postseason berth. However, they didn't do their part against Milwaukee as Aaron Nola gave up home runs to Brice Turang and Christian Yelich while the offense went 0-for-12 with runners in scoring position. "It's always frustrating," Philadelphia interim manager Don Mattingly said. "Everybody wants to get a hit in those spots. ... You feel like if you can get a run here and a run there, it really changes the game." The Phillies will look to bounce back behind rookie right-hander Andrew Painter (3-10, 5.59 ERA), who is winless in his past five starts. He absorbed a 10-3 loss to the New York Mets in his last outing, as he gave up four runs in 5 1/3 innings, allowing a pair of home runs in the process. "I don't worry about Paint's toughness, honestly," Mattingly said. "(I see him) bouncing back and continuing to make pitches. I don't worry about Paint from the standpoint of growth, handling situations." Painter was the bulk innings pitcher against the Brewers on June 12 and yielded five runs in five innings in a 6-0 defeat. He did not take the loss. Right-hander Bryse Wilson (0-0, 3.67) will make his first start of the season after appearing in 15 games out of the bullpen for three teams. He made one appearance for the Phillies on June 18 and then saw action in two games for the Chicago Cubs before joining the Brewers. Wilson, who has a 2.55 ERA in 12 appearances for Milwaukee, has been out since late August with a back injury. He knows his job generally is to eat innings, particularly with the Brewers looking to keep their pitching staff healthy and rested with the postseason right around the corner. "If I come in and we're down a lot of runs, I know that innings have to be covered," Wilson said recently. "I just go in and do the best I can to cover as many innings to where the next day, we have a much better chance to win because everybody's available and there's more options to go to in the bullpen." Wilson has appeared in five career games (three starts) against the Phillies, going 1-2 with a 6.35 ERA. --Field Level Media

item.title: UE mantiene contactos de alto nivel con EEUU por supuesto plan de prohibir exportación de diésel: portavoz
item.description: Un portavoz de la Comisión Europea dijo el jueves que se están manteniendo contactos de alto nivel entre la Unión Europea y Estados Unidos en medio de los rumores sobre un plan estadounidense para prohibir las exportaciones de gasóleo, algo que, según la UE, podría tener un impacto negativo para ambas partes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Un portavoz de la Comisión Europea dijo el jueves que se están manteniendo contactos de alto nivel entre la Unión Europea y Estados Unidos en medio de los rumores sobre un plan estadounidense para prohibir las exportaciones de gasóleo, algo que, según la UE, podría tener un impacto negativo para ambas partes. Politico informó de que Washington está preparando una prohibición de 90 días a las exportaciones de gasóleo ante el repunte de los precios previo a las elecciones de mitad de mandato de noviembre, aunque el secretario de Energía estadounidense, Chris Wright, lo desmintió. "Se están manteniendo contactos de alto nivel entre la Unión Europea y la Administración estadounidense. Esperamos que unos socios cercanos se consulten mutuamente antes de adoptar medidas que afecten a los mercados comunes", declaró Olof Gill a los periodistas. Los analistas han señalado que una prohibición de las exportaciones de gasóleo por parte de Estados Unidos contribuiría poco a aliviar los precios en ese país, pero que incluso una prohibición parcial podría provocar escasez de producto en Europa y en otros lugares. El gasóleo es el combustible que impulsa el transporte, la maquinaria agrícola y otros equipos utilizados para producir y transportar mercancías, y el aumento de los precios del combustible aviva la inflación al encarecer el costo de todo, desde los productos alimenticios hasta los materiales industriales. Los precios del gasóleo se han disparado debido a los bajos niveles de existencias y a las perturbaciones causadas por las guerras en Ucrania y Oriente Medio. Rusia, el segundo mayor exportador mundial tras Estados unidos, prohibió las exportaciones de gasóleo en julio hasta finales de septiembre. Una prohibición de las exportaciones por parte de Washington obligaría a las refinerías estadounidenses a recortar la cantidad de crudo que procesan, lo que a su vez reduciría la producción de gasolina y otros productos y haría subir los precios de esos combustibles, según han señalado analistas y operadores. La UE es importadora neta de gasóleo y tendría que competir con compradores de América Latina, África y Asia por un volumen menor de suministros disponibles.

item.title: Tivit investirá R$1 bi em aquisições na América Latina
item.description: A companhia brasileira de tecnologia Tivit anunciou nesta quinta-feira um programa de R$1 bilhão em aquisições na América Latina, em estratégia para ampliar portfólio de tecnologias proprietárias e criar plataformas especializadas em setores estratégicos.
item.dc:creator: Igor Sodre
item.content:encoded: A companhia brasileira de tecnologia Tivit anunciou nesta quinta-feira um programa de R$1 bilhão em aquisições na América Latina, em estratégia para ampliar portfólio de tecnologias proprietárias e criar plataformas especializadas em setores estratégicos. O programa priorizará a aquisição de companhias desenvolvedoras de software e hardware proprietários com faturamento entre R$20 milhões e R$200 milhões por ano. Não há prazo preestabelecido para desembolso dos recursos. A Tivit foi adquirida no ano passado pelo grupo italiano Almaviva. "Ficamos um ano nessa jornada de integração e agora estamos mais maduros. Então esse momento acaba abrindo espaço para um investimento mais agressivo", disse Mitri Brito, diretor de estratégia, fusões e aquisições e marketing da Tivit. Segundo o executivo, o investimento de R$1 bilhão será financiado por meio da geração própria de caixa da Tivit, conforme as novas aquisições forem concretizadas. "Vemos oportunidades no nosso mercado", acrescentou Brito. Os investimentos estão organizados em seis plataformas verticais, sendo elas: Governo, com foco em Segurança Pública e Defesa, Mercado Financeiro, Transportes, Manufatura, Saúde e 'Utilities', além de duas plataformas horizontais, Inteligência Artificial e Segurança Cibernética. Para executar o programa, a companhia desenvolveu estudos dedicados por indústria, analisando necessidades dos clientes, dinâmica competitiva, tendências tecnológicas e oportunidades de inovação. "Durante o estudo, nós observamos oportunidades de tecnologia, mas também percebemos dores verticais, específicas de cada indústria. Para resolver isso, a avaliação foi de que precisávamos tanto de uma abordagem horizontal quanto vertical", disse Brito. A Tivit mapeou 620 empresas que poderiam ser alvos de aquisição. Dessas, 308 foram selecionadas e abordadas. No fim, a Tivit realizou conversas com 75 potenciais alvos e mantém 15 oportunidades em fase de aprofundamento de negocição. O executivo disse que as empresas que ficaram de fora do programa foram filtradas por motivos distintos, como desalinhamento de interesse por parte dos fundadores, falta de maturidade comercial ou modelos de negócios não escaláveis, enquanto as 15 finalistas avançaram por meio de análises qualitativas de potencial de escala. "Olhamos com muito bons olhos a IA. Temos serviços e produtos no portfólio tanto para (segmentos) horizontais quanto para verticais", disse o executivo. O grupo Almaviva destinou mais de R$6 bilhões a operações de fusão e aquisição nos últimos dois anos, sendo aproximadamente metade desse montante foi direcionado à América Latina. Além da Tivit, o grupo ampliou sua presença em diferentes mercados por meio de aquisições como a Iteris, especializada em mobilidade inteligente nos Estados Unidos; Mabrian, voltada a tecnologias para turismo; e a B.M. Tecnologie Industriali, especializada em soluções para saneamento e gestão de água.

item.title: Canada July retail sales fall 0.7%; seen up 1.3% in August
item.description: Canadian monthly retail sales fell by 0.7% in July, marginally better than an average of analysts' expectations, primarily led by declines at general merchandise retailers, data showed on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Promit Mukherjee
item.content:encoded: Canadian monthly retail sales fell by 0.7% in July, marginally better than an average of analysts' expectations, primarily led by declines at general merchandise retailers, data showed on Thursday. Retail sales, which include purchases of cars, furniture, food and gasoline, are considered an early indicator of gross domestic product growth and account for about 40% of consumer spending. Retail sales dropped to C$73.70 billion ($52.25 billion) in July from C$74.25 billion in the prior month, Statistics Canada said. However, sales are likely to rebound once again in August and increase by 1.3%, the statistics agency said in an advance estimate. Sales were down in eight of nine sub-sectors in July. In volume terms, retail sales decreased 1.1%. General merchandise retailers, stores that sell a broad mix of unrelated goods from groceries to food and apparel to electronics, posted the biggest decline in sales in July. This category, which contributes up to 15% of total retail sales, slumped by 1.9%. Sales at motor vehicles and parts dealers, which account for the biggest share of retail sales, dropped by 0.8%, data showed. Purchases at food and beverage retailers, the second-biggest category, dropped 0.1%; however, sales at supermarket and grocery retailers hardly changed. The category of building materials was the only sub-sector which posted an increase, with sales increasing 0.8%. "We don't expect the momentum to extend, as lingering trade uncertainty will likely weigh on discretionary spending ahead," Katherine Judge, senior economist at CIBC Capital Markets, wrote in a note. This means the Bank of Canada will not be raising rates in the near term, she added. ($1=$1.4105 Canadian)

item.title: Morgan Stanley Asia deals leaked in missent email attachment
item.description: A senior Morgan Stanley banker covering financial sponsors in Asia accidentally leaked their deal pipeline in an email sent to clients, according to six people with knowledge of the matter.
item.dc:creator: Kane Wu, Julie Zhu
item.content:encoded: A senior Morgan Stanley (MS.N) banker covering financial sponsors in Asia accidentally leaked their deal pipeline in an email sent to clients, according to six people with knowledge of the matter. The banker attached the financial sponsors group's deal pipeline by mistake in a weekly update email he sent to clients, the people said. "Morgan Stanley takes client confidentiality extremely seriously. We promptly took steps to address this inadvertent sharing of information and we continue to engage with relevant parties," a spokesperson for the Wall Street bank said in an emailed response to Reuters on Thursday. The banker later retracted the email and apologised for the mishap, urging recipients to delete copies of the attachment and refrain from circulating the document, according to a screenshot of the email seen by Reuters. The list, dated September 21, contained about 60 live IPO, M&A and block trade deals across Greater China, South Korea, Southeast Asia, India and the EMEA region. It also included over 50 deals that were categorised as "pitching" and nearly 30 deals categorised as "on hold". All of those deals concern Asian companies. The vast majority of the companies on the list are portfolios of major global and regional private equity and venture capital firms. Bloomberg first reported on the incident late on Wednesday. The list did not contain details of any of the deals, and a lot of them have already been reported, according to some people who received the email.

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Deutsche Unternehmen bleiben im Ausland begehrt. 107 Milliarden Dollar zahlten ausländische Konzerne und Investoren in den ersten neun Monaten 2026 für Firmen aus Deutschland, doppelt so viel wie ein Jahr zuvor, wie aus den am Donnerstag veröffentlichten "League Tables" des Londoner Börsenbetreibers und Finanzdatenanbieters LSEG (LSEG.L) hervorgeht. Auf ihr Konto gehen damit fast 60 Prozent des gesamten Volumens von Fusionen und Übernahmen mit deutscher Beteiligung von 179,3 Milliarden Dollar (Stand: 23. September). Bei fünf der sechs größten Deals kam der Käufer aus dem Ausland. Insgesamt wurden deutsche Unternehmen für 123,1 Milliarden Dollar verkauft, das ist schon jetzt mehr als im gesamten Jahr 2025. Aber auch deutsche Konzerne kauften im Ausland - vor allem in den USA - für 47,1 Milliarden Dollar ein und gaben damit mehr als doppelt so viel aus wie ein Jahr zuvor. Was auffällt: Während der Wert der Fusionen und Übernahmen um 47 Prozent stieg und damit so hoch war wie zuletzt 2018, ist die Zahl der Transaktionen um vier Prozent gesunken. "Wir sehen im laufenden Jahr ein Comeback großer, strategischer Transaktionen", sagte Christopher Droege, Chef des Geschäfts mit Fusionen und Übernahmen bei der US-Investmentbank Goldman Sachs für Deutschland und Österreich der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. Die Käufer ließen sich dabei von höheren Zinsen, steigenden Anleiherenditen und geopolitischer Unsicherheit nicht beirren. "Größe ist im globalen Wettbewerb zunehmend eine Voraussetzung für Erfolg." Deutsche Unternehmen seien attraktiv: "Insbesondere die Verbindung der hohen industriellen Fertigungskompetenz mit industrieller KI ist eine Chance für die deutsche Wirtschaft", sagte Droege. DIE GRÖSSTEN ÜBERNAHMEN: * Der finnische Aufzughersteller Kone (KNEBV.HE) greift nach dem deutschen Konkurrenten TK Elevator. Kone bietet den beiden Finanzinvestoren Advent und Cinven 20 Milliarden Euro in bar und in eigenen Aktien. Einschließlich Schulden hat die Übernahme einen Wert von 34,4 Milliarden Dollar. Allerdings müssen ihr noch die Kartellbehörden zustimmen - das ist nicht trivial, weil TKE und Kone den Markt zusammen mit zwei Konkurrenten dominieren. Auch die ehemalige Mutter ThyssenKrupp (TKAG.DE) als Minderheitsaktionär würde von einem Verkauf finanziell profitieren. * Der US-Fahrdienst Uber (UBER.N) greift für bis zu 14,6 Milliarden Dollar nach dem Essenslieferdienst Delivery Hero (DHER.DE) . Das Berliner Unternehmen war unter Beschuss von Aktionären gekommen, die den Rückzug von Vorstandschef Niklas Östberg erzwingen wollten. Uber nutzte die Gelegenheit und den von den EU-Kartellbehörden forcierten Anteilsabbau von Großaktionär Prosus (PRX.AS) zum Einstieg und zur Aufstockung seiner Anteile. Der US-Konzern liefert mit "Uber Eats" ebenfalls Essen aus Restaurants nach Hause. Inzwischen läuft ein Übernahmeangebot an alle Delivery-Hero-Aktionäre. Uber hat sich bis Ende der vergangenen Woche bereits 49 Prozent der Anteile gesichert. * Der Pharma- und Technologiekonzern Merck (MRCG.DE) baut sein Life-Science-Geschäft aus und übernimmt den US-Laborausrüster Bio-Techne (TECH.O) für 11,4 Milliarden Dollar. Damit stärkt das Darmstädter Unternehmen seinen Zugang zu wachstumsstarken Märkten wie der Zell- und Gentherapie sowie der Präzisionsdiagnostik. Die Übernahme ist der erste große strategische Schritt des neuen Merck-Chefs Kai Beckmann. * Die Hamburger Containerreederei Hapag-Lloyd (HLAG.DE) will für umgerechnet 8,3 Milliarden Dollar einschließlich Schulden die israelische ZIM Integrated Shipping schlucken. ZIM ist die zehntgrößte Containerreederei weltweit, Hapag-Lloyd die Nummer fünf. Um das Unternehmen aus Haifa hatten auch größere Konkurrenten wie Maersk (MAERSKb.CO) und MSC gebuhlt. * UniCredit (CRDI.MI) hat mit einem Aktientausch-Angebot an die Commerzbank (CBKG.DE) -Aktionäre seinen Anteil an der Frankfurter Bank auf 49 Prozent aufgestockt und sich damit freie Hand für weitere Aktienkäufe am Markt verschafft. UniCredit-Chef Andrea Orcel ringt derzeit um eine Komplettübernahme der zweitgrößten börsennotierten Bank Deutschlands, die er auf lange Sicht mit der Münchner UniCredit-Tochter HypoVereinsbank zusammenführen will. Die bisherige Aufstockung des Anteils wird in den League Tables mit 7,0 Milliarden Dollar bewertet. * Nach dem Heiztechnik-Spezialisten Viessmann wird ein weiteres deutsches Familienunternehmen in die USA verkauft. Der württembergische Ventilatoren- und Lüfter-Hersteller ebm-papst geht für 5,9 Milliarden Dollar an die börsennotierte Madison Air (MAIR.N) aus Chicago, die bereits zu den Kunden des Unternehmens aus Mulfingen gehört. EBM-Papst erhofft sich davon vor allem einen besseren und schnelleren Zugang zum US-Markt, wo das Geschäft mit Rechenzentren besonders boomt. Die Ausrüstung von Rechenzentren steht bereits für rund ein Drittel des Umsatzes von EBM-Papst. * In einem wochenlangen Bieterwettstreit um die Augsburger Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) -Dieselmotorentochter Everllence hat sich der Finanzinvestor Bain Capital durchgesetzt. Der neue Mehrheitseigentümer verspricht sich Rückenwind durch die Energiewende beim Antrieb von Schiffen und durch den steigenden Energiebedarf wegen des Booms bei Rechenzentren. Bain übernimmt 51 Prozent der Anteile. Insidern zufolge wurde Everllence dabei mit deutlich mehr als neun Milliarden Euro bewertet, Volkswagen beziffert den Gesamterlös auf 7,4 Milliarden Euro. Der genaue Transaktionswert lässt sich daraus laut LSEG aber nicht ermitteln, so dass der Deal nicht in der Rangliste auftaucht. DIE ERFOLGREICHSTEN BERATER: * Bei fünf der sechs größten Transaktionen dieses Jahres mischte die US-Investmentbank Goldman Sachs mit - auf Seiten des Käufers oder des Verkäufers. Das macht sie erneut unangefochten zur Nummer eins in der Rangliste der erfolgreichsten Berater. Goldman Sachs beriet in den ersten neun Monaten bei 29 Transaktionen im Wert von 99,0 Milliarden Dollar. Die Deutsche Bank schob sich mit 24 Übernahmen im Wert von 73,7 Milliarden Dollar auf Platz zwei - vor einem Jahr war sie Vierte. Auf den Rängen drei bis fünf folgen erneut drei US-Banken: Bank of America (BofA Securities) mit 18 Mandaten im Volumen von 68,2 Milliarden Dollar, Morgan Stanley (64,8 Milliarden) und JPMorgan (59,0 Milliarden). * Das Geschäft mit Eigenkapital-Emissionen und -Platzierungen (ECM) hat weiter angezogen, bleibt aber aufgrund des Ausbleibens größerer Börsengänge auf niedrigem Niveau. JPMorgan führt vor Goldman Sachs und der Deutschen Bank. * Bei Fremdkapital-Transaktionen verteidigt die Deutsche Bank mit 116 Emissionen im Volumen von 32,4 Milliarden Dollar ihren unangefochtenen Spitzenplatz. Direkt dahinter liegt wieder JPMorgan (21,2 Milliarden Dollar), gefolgt von Barclays (18,2 Milliarden) und BNP Paribas (17,6 Milliarden).

item.title: Isabel Schnabel verso dimissioni Bce - fonti
item.description: Isabel Schnabel, membro del Comitato esecutivo della Banca centrale europea (Bce), lascerà anticipatamente l’istituzione per assumere un incarico di rilievo presso il Fondo monetario internazionale (Fmi).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Isabel Schnabel, membro del Comitato esecutivo della Banca centrale europea (Bce), lascerà anticipatamente l’istituzione per assumere un incarico di rilievo presso il Fondo monetario internazionale (Fmi). L’annuncio è imminente e potrebbe arrivare in giornata, secondo quanto riferito a Reuters da due fonti informate sulla questione. Il mandato di otto anni di Schnabel, responsabile delle operazioni di mercato della Bce, sarebbe dovuto scadere alla fine del 2027, ma il Fmi sarebbe intenzionato a trovare un nuovo direttore del proprio dipartimento di mercato entro la fine di quest’anno, hanno detto le fonti. Bce e Fmi non hanno commentato.

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Wegen ukrainischer Drohnenangriffe auf die Infrastruktur für den Getreideexport hat der Gouverneur der südrussischen Agrarregion Krasnodar den Ausnahmezustand ausgerufen. Die massiven Attacken auf die Anlagen hätten den Hafenbetrieb lahmgelegt und die Schifffahrt im Schwarzen Meer gestört, teilte Gouverneur Weniamin Kondratjew laut der Nachrichtenagentur Interfax am Donnerstag mit. Durch den Ausnahmezustand können betroffene Betriebe finanzielle Entschädigungen erhalten. Den Angaben zufolge können die Landwirte einen Großteil ihrer Ernte nicht verkaufen, was zu einem Überangebot auf dem russischen Getreidemarkt führt. Krasnodar hat in diesem Jahr 11,4 Millionen Tonnen Getreide und Hülsenfrüchte geerntet, fast zwei Millionen Tonnen mehr als im Jahr 2025. Besonders die Hafenstadt Noworossijsk, ein wichtiger Umschlagplatz für russisches Öl und Getreide, ist immer wieder Ziel ukrainischer Drohnenangriffe. Sowohl Russland als auch die Ukraine haben in den vergangenen Monaten ihre Angriffe auf Getreideschiffe im Schwarzen Meer verstärkt, was die Weltmarktpreise in die Höhe trieb. Der Kreml erklärte in dieser Woche, es gebe weitere diplomatische Gespräche über einen Vorschlag der Türkei zur sicheren Durchfahrt von Getreideschiffen im Schwarzen Meer. Bis zu einer Einigung suche Russland nach alternativen Routen für seine Exporte. Im Juli 2022 hatten die Türkei und die UN das sogenannte Schwarzmeer-Getreideabkommen vermittelt, um trotz des Krieges sichere ukrainische Exporte zu ermöglichen. Russland war jedoch im folgenden Jahr aus der Vereinbarung ausgestiegen. Zur Begründung hieß es, dass die eigenen Nahrungsmittel- und Düngemittelexporte behindert würden.

item.title: Letzter Siemens-Vertreter verlässt Aufsichtsrat von Siemens Energy
item.description: Sechs Jahre nach der Abspaltung der Energietechnik-Sparte verlässt der letzte Siemens-Vertreter den Aufsichtsrat der Siemens Energy AG. Der langjährige Siemens-Infrastrukturtechnik-Vorstand Matthias Rebellius scheide zum Monatsende auf eigenen Wunsch aus dem Gremium aus, teilte Siemens Energy am Donnerstag mit. Rebellius' Vorstandsvertrag bei Siemens läuft ebenfalls im September aus. Nachdem der Anteil des Münchner Technologiekonzerns an Siemens Energy auf weniger als fünf Prozent gesunken ist, hat Siemens keinen Anspruch mehr auf einen Sitz im Aufsichtsrat. Der ehemalige Siemens-Chef Joe Kaeser fungiert aber weiter als Aufsichtsratschef.

Der langjährige Siemens-Infrastrukturtechnik-Vorstand Matthias Rebellius scheide zum Monatsende auf eigenen Wunsch aus dem Gremium aus, teilte Siemens Energy am Donnerstag mit. item.title: Fincantieri-Leonardo, contratto da 3,7 miliardi per due nuovi cacciatorpedinieri della Marina
item.description: Orizzonte Sistemi Navali (Osn), joint venture tra Fincantieri e Leonardo , ha firmato con Occar un contratto del valore complessivo di circa 3,7 miliardi di euro per lo sviluppo e la costruzione di due cacciatorpedinieri di nuova generazione destinati alla Marina Militare italiana.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Orizzonte Sistemi Navali (Osn), joint venture tra Fincantieri (FCT.MI) e Leonardo (LDOF.MI) , ha firmato con Occar un contratto del valore complessivo di circa 3,7 miliardi di euro per lo sviluppo e la costruzione di due cacciatorpedinieri di nuova generazione destinati alla Marina Militare italiana. Il contratto, si legge in una nota congiunta, comprende circa 1,3 miliardi di euro di opzioni e sarà seguito nelle prossime settimane da contratti di subfornitura per circa 1,8 miliardi a Fincantieri e circa 1,7 miliardi a Leonardo, anch'essi comprensivi di quote opzionali. "Le nuove navi saranno progettate per operare all’interno di forze multinazionali altamente interconnesse e saranno caratterizzate da elevati livelli di digitalizzazione, automazione e integrazione tra sensori, sistemi d’arma, sistemi di comando e controllo multidominio e sistemi di gestione della piattaforma", spiega la nota. Le nuove unità DDX sostituiranno progressivamente i cacciatorpedinieri della classe Horizon e saranno progettate per operare in scenari ad alta intensità, con capacità avanzate di difesa aerea e antimissile, integrazione multidominio e impiego di sistemi unmanned. Fincantieri agirà come system integrator della piattaforma navale, mentre Leonardo fornirà il sistema di combattimento. La consegna delle due unità è prevista rispettivamente nel 2033 e nel 2035. item.title: VW-Tochter MOIA startet Robotaxi-Fahrten in den USA
item.description: Die Volkswagen-Tochter MOIA America hat in den USA ihren ersten Passagierbetrieb mit selbstfahrenden Taxis gestartet. Zusammen mit dem Mobilitätsanbieter Beep bietet das Unternehmen Fahrten in der Gemeinde Lake Nona in Orlando im US-Bundesstaat Florida an, wie die Firmen am Donnerstag mitteilten. Die autonom fahrenden Fahrzeuge vom Typ ID.Buzz sind mit einem System des Entwicklers Mobileye ausgestattet. In der aktuellen Phase befindet sich zur Sicherheit noch ein Mensch an Bord. Fahrgäste können die Fahrten über eine App von Beep auf drei festgelegten Routen buchen.

item.content:encoded: Die Volkswagen-Tochter MOIA America hat in den USA ihren ersten Passagierbetrieb mit selbstfahrenden Taxis gestartet. Zusammen mit dem Mobilitätsanbieter Beep bietet das Unternehmen Fahrten in der Gemeinde Lake Nona in Orlando im US-Bundesstaat Florida an, wie die Firmen am Donnerstag mitteilten. Die autonom fahrenden Fahrzeuge vom Typ ID.Buzz sind mit einem System des Entwicklers Mobileye (MBLY.O) ausgestattet. In der aktuellen Phase befindet sich zur Sicherheit noch ein Mensch an Bord. Fahrgäste können die Fahrten über eine App von Beep auf drei festgelegten Routen buchen. Florida gilt als einer der US-Bundesstaaten mit den liberalsten Gesetzen für das Testen autonomer Fahrzeuge. MOIA America bereitet zudem in Los Angeles und Austin den Start kommerzieller Dienste vor und nimmt dort Testfahrten vor. Damit tritt die VW-Tochter gegen schon länger auf dem Robotaxi-Markt etablierte Konkurrenten wie die Alphabet (GOOGL.O) -Tochter Waymo und Tesla (TSLA.O) an, die nach Testphasen den kommerziellen Betrieb vorantreiben.

item.title: Schnabel vai deixar o cargo no BC dando início a uma reorganização do conselho, dizendo fontes
item.description: Isabel Schnabel, membro do Banco Central Europeu, vai anunciar sua renúncia nesta quinta-feira para ingressar no Fundo Monetário Internacional, informaram duas fontes à Reuters, dando início a uma longa reorganização dos cargos mais importantes do conselho do banco.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Isabel Schnabel, membro do Banco Central Europeu, vai anunciar sua renúncia nesta quinta-feira para ingressar no Fundo Monetário Internacional, informaram duas fontes à Reuters, dando início a uma longa reorganização dos cargos mais importantes do conselho do banco. Schnabel, chefe das operações de mercado do BCE, deveria permanecer no cargo até o final de 2027, mas o FMI estava empenhado em encontrar um novo diretor para seu departamento de mercado até o final deste ano, disseram as fontes. Tanto o BCE quanto o FMI se recusaram a comentar. A saída de Schnabel, da Alemanha, dá início ao que deve ser um complicado jogo de xadrez político, já que o economista-chefe do BCE, Philip Lane, deve deixar o cargo em maio, enquanto a presidente do BCE, Christine Lagarde — ela própria alvo de rumores persistentes de renúncia —, deixará o cargo até outubro próximo, no máximo. Isso sugere que a substituição de Schnabel fará parte de um acordo político mais amplo, e não de uma simples nomeação, já que Alemanha, Espanha, Holanda e França estão disputando assentos de poder no conselho. Embora tecnicamente qualquer país possa disputar o cargo de Schnabel, os três principais do bloco — Alemanha, França e Itália — têm, de fato, um assento permanente no conselho. No entanto, se a Alemanha simplesmente substituísse Schnabel por outro candidato, isso significa que Berlim não disputaria a presidência do BCE assim que o cargo de Lagarde ficar vago. É por isso que fontes próximas ao assunto afirmam que qualquer acordo sobre o cargo de Schnabel provavelmente envolverá também as outras duas posições. A Espanha está fazendo lobby para que o gerente geral do Banco de Compensações Internacionais, Pablo Hernández de Cos, torne-se o próximo presidente do BCE, enquanto a Holanda defende Klaas Knot, ex-presidente do banco central do país. A Alemanha estava considerando o presidente do Bundesbank, Joachim Nagel, para a presidência, mas seu compromisso parece ter enfraquecido recentemente e o país pode optar por um cargo diferente. Enquanto isso, a França, que já proporcionou ao BCE dois presidentes — Lagarde e Jean-Claude Trichet —, espera conseguir o cargo de economista-chefe, informaram fontes anteriormente. (Reportagem de Balazs Koranyi e Francesco Canepa)

item.title: Braves' Tyler Mahle eager to keep up stellar form vs. Reds
item.description: Tyler Mahle, Atlanta's most impactful trade deadline acquisition this season, will take the mound on Thursday when the Braves host the Cincinnati Reds in their final home game of the season.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Tyler Mahle, Atlanta's most impactful trade deadline acquisition this season, will take the mound on Thursday when the Braves host the Cincinnati Reds in their final home game of the season. The Braves (93-65) won Wednesday's game 3-2 in 10 innings to square the three-game series at one victory apiece. Cincinnati (73-85) has lost three of its last four games and is 29-33 since the All-Star break. Mahle (7-10, 3.81 ERA) will be opposed by Cincinnati's Brady Singer (6-15, 5.67) on Thursday in a battle of right-handers. Mahle, obtained from San Francisco at the deadline, has pitched his way into position as the No. 2 man in the Atlanta rotation behind Chris Sale. He was 3-9 with a 5.13 ERA in 18 starts with San Francisco, but since joining Atlanta is 4-1 with a 1.28 ERA in eight starts. In his last start on Friday at Houston, Mahle pitched six innings and allowed only one run on three hits. He has not given up more than two runs in any start since joining the Braves and has been caught each time by veteran Sean Murphy. "He can throw strikes with all of his pitches," Atlanta manager Walt Weiss said. "Murph has done a nice job with him, he enjoys catching him. He can throw the ball where he wants to. It's nice for a catcher when guys can do that." Mahle's lone career appearance against the Reds came this season. He allowed a season-high eight runs in four innings to take the loss on April 15. Singer will look to end a two-game losing streak during which he has allowed 15 runs in 7 1/3 innings. He gave up seven runs in 3 1/3 innings - his second-shortest stint of the season - in his last outing on Thursday against the Los Angeles Dodgers. "I think the biggest thing, try to figure out a way to have some command and put the ball where you want to and just keep working," Singer said. "We're doing stuff during the week, trying to figure stuff out. Matt Tracy (assistant pitching coach) is trying to help me out as much as he can and we work on those things and we've had good weeks. It's just not really carrying over to the games." Singer faced the Braves on May 30 and worked five innings, allowing three runs on four hits and four walks. In five career starts against Atlanta, Singer is 1-4 with a 5.46 ERA. The Braves activated setup man Robert Suarez from the injured list on Wednesday and optioned fellow right-hander Owen Murphy to Triple-A Gwinnett. Suarez missed 80 games with right elbow inflammation. He pitched one inning and allowed a run in his return. Atlanta right fielder Ronald Acuna Jr. is expected to be back in the lineup on Thursday. He missed Wednesday's game after fouling a ball off his left shin on Tuesday. Acuna wanted to play on Wednesday, but Weiss opted to give him an additional day off as a precautionary measure. Atlanta's Mauricio Dubon had two hits on Wednesday and extended his hitting streak to 11 games. Cincinnati's Elly De La Cruz did not reach base on Wednesday and needs one homer and one steal to become the fourth 30-30 player in franchise history. --Field Level Media

item.title: Tech and world leaders split over AI
item.description: Hello!
item.dc:creator: Sharon Kimathi
item.content:encoded: Hello! It has been quite a dramatic United Nations General Assembly this week as world leaders gathered in New York for their annual diplomatic talks. But some were not so diplomatic. I’m sure by now most of you have seen clips of US President Donald Trump’s speech where he said he could annihilate Iran without a peace deal and predicted one would be reached after US midterm elections on November 3 when the makeup of Congress will be decided.[USN:L1N45E0M0 TEXT:" Click here"] for a summary of what else Trump said at the UN. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian accused Trump of a "bullying mentality", saying Iran would not surrender in the war with the US but remained open to diplomacy to end the conflict. Click here to sign up to the Reuters Iran Briefing newsletter to stay informed with the latest developments and analysis of the Iran war. But today’s focus is not about the war of words. Instead, we look at the discussions around artificial intelligence that took place between tech companies and world leaders. What did the tech heads say? The world's leading [USN:L6N45E0VV TEXT:"AI companies warned"] the United Nations Security Council on Wednesday of the risks posed by AI to humanity, appealing for governments to work together to manage the increasingly powerful technology. [USN:L4N456128 TEXT:"AI industry leaders are split"] over how fast companies should develop the increasingly powerful technology, as Anthropic's Dario Amodei, OpenAI's Sam Altman and xAI's Elon Musk call for a coordinated slowdown. Meta's Mark Zuckerberg appeared to break away from other AI leaders, favouring market-led safeguards, while Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang dismissed the need for new regulations. Amodei told the 15-member council, which is charged with maintaining international peace and security, that if managed poorly, he believed "AI could be a risk to humanity as a whole." "For all the differences of the people in this room, we must put aside those differences in order to confront this global opportunity and global threat that is being presented to us at the same time. No leader, no company and no nation can manage this alone," Amodei said. Hugging Face co-founder Clément Delangue highlighted the role of AI tools in defending against cyberattacks, citing an incident in which US OpenAI's AI agents breached Hugging Face's infrastructure after escaping their testing environment. "We were attacked by AI, but more importantly, we defended ourselves with AI," he told the council. Delangue said Hugging Face relied on a Chinese AI model to help defend against the attack by OpenAI's AI agents because it faced fewer restrictions than comparable US tools. His remarks underscored the growing presence of Chinese AI products, which have gained users globally in part because they can offer lower-cost alternatives to American models. What about heads of state and government? Governments around the world have struggled to keep pace with rapid advances in AI. The US and China, the two leading powers in AI development, have taken different approaches to oversight. Trump has argued that the US does not need new AI-specific regulations, while China has imposed rules governing AI algorithms and training data, including requirements that AI-generated content be clearly labeled. Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese told reporters in New York that an AI agent developed by OpenAI[USN:L4N45F1E8 TEXT:" infiltrated"] an Australian government website in June, accessing public and non-public files. British [USN:L8N45E18S TEXT:"Prime Minister Andy Burnham"] told the United Nations that Britain was ready to lead an international effort to establish AI standards, citing concerns that the technology could outpace safeguards and pose mounting national security risks. "We've all[USN:L4N456128 TEXT:" heard the warnings"] – which we must heed," he said in his inaugural speech to the UN General Assembly. "I know how worried people are. So we have to rise to this moment." Talking Points Indonesia’s Borneo wildfires: Click here for an insightful photo essay on the all-women firefighting group called The Power of Mama who are at the front lines of battling the worst wildfires in 11 years on the Indonesian islands of Borneo and Sumatra. The fires have been raging longer than usual this year and have been made worse by the drought-inducing El Niño weather pattern. Palestinian olives bulldozed: Palestinian villagers wailed over the mangled remains of their olive trees after Israel's military uprooted them with bulldozers, days ahead of the annual olive harvest in the occupied West Bank. Olives are the backbone of Palestinian agriculture, a sector that accounts for around 8% of GDP and more than 60,000 jobs, according to the Palestinian Authority's agriculture ministry. [USN:L8N45F1FN TEXT:"Click here"] to read the full Reuters story. Mexico Hurricane Polo: Residents of Mexico's Pacific beach towns were preparing for heavy rain and winds of 145 mph (230 kph) as [USN:L8N45F0LO TEXT:"Hurricane Polo, a powerful Category 4 storm"], tracked northwestward just offshore, threatening flooding and mudslides along the country's southwestern coast. Michigan climate lawsuit: US District Judge Jane Beckering in Grand Rapids rejected a [USN:L1N45F002 TEXT:"lawsuit against BP, Chevron, Exxon and Shell"], filed in January by Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel, which accused the major oil companies of colluding to forestall competition in renewable energy, including electric vehicles, a decision in line with prior rulings in similar cases. US critical minerals funding: The US Export-Import Bank plans to fund up to [USN:L1N45E106 TEXT:"$7 billion worth of critical minerals"] and energy projects in Argentina as it seeks more access to Western hemisphere energy and critical minerals, according to a document seen by Reuters. The move is part of a push to deepen economic cooperation between Washington and Buenos Aires. In Conversation Woochong Um, CEO of the multi-sector Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet, shares his thoughts on this year’s UN General Assembly: "The world faces profound challenges, from climate change to inequality, and the rapid transformations brought by artificial intelligence. “The truth is that these challenges are profoundly interconnected. “While the world grapples with the future prospect of AI super intelligence, we must also acknowledge the extraordinary opportunity AI offers to build a more prosperous, inclusive and equitable world, today. “That starts with access to electricity. Currently, more than 650 million people live without any access to electricity at all. By making power grids smarter, AI can reduce outages, increase efficiencies, show us where to integrate renewables and in doing so, bring reliable electricity to communities that have waited for it for far too long. “We absolutely need guardrails around AI to ensure our safer future. And we absolutely need it to accelerate our efforts today to power clean, abundant, economic growth in emerging and developing economies.” ESG Spotlight Environmental groups and volunteers saving mussels from shallow waters in the Czech Republic take today’s spotlight. Operators of [USN:L8N45F0XS TEXT:"the Slapy dam"], upstream from Prague, were forced to reduce its water level to record lows due to a severe drought that hit the nation this year, to maintain flows downstream. Volunteers rushed to rescue the protected mussels from the newly exposed banks into deeper waters elsewhere. Mussels act as important filters for the water, keeping rivers and streams clean.
